findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: map_store_offers, validate_angle_gaps, pick_ad_type, get_feedback_reply · Public sink: pick_ad_type, submit_feedback · Destructive: pick_ad_type, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: map_store_offers, validate_angle_gaps, pick_ad_type, get_feedback_reply · Public sink: pick_ad_type, submit_feedback · Destructive: pick_ad_type, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
